data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS danas
data.name: dtDanas

data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE()-1, 112) AS jucer

data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS danas
data.name: dtdanas_lazy

data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE()+1, 112) AS sutra
data.name: dtSutra_lazy

data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), datumdok, 112) AS DatumTreeFokus from Fakture where FaktureId=@Id
data.name: dtDatumTreeFokus

data.command: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), datumdok, 112) AS DatumTreeFokus from Fakture where FaktureId=@Id
data.name: dtDatumTreeFokusCopy

data.command: select CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), datumdok, 112)+'_'+convert(varchar(10),partneriid) AS KupciTreeFokus from fakture where FaktureId=@Id
data.name: dtKupciTreeFokus

data.command: select CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), datumdok, 112)+'_'+convert(varchar(10),operateriid) AS OperateriTreeFokus from fakture where FaktureId=@Id
data.name: dtOperateriTreeFokus

data.command: select CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), datumdok, 112)+'_1' as StatusiTreeFokus from fakture where FaktureId=@Id
data.name: dtStatusiTreeFokus

data.command: select * from rabati
data.name: dtRabati

data.command: select VrstaPromId from VrstaProm where Sifra = '30'
data.name: dtVrstaProm

data.command: select dbo.fnTecaj(@DatumDok, @DevValuteId) as Tecaj
data.name: dtDatumValidate

data.command: update Fakture set DevValuteId=@DevValuteId, VrBodaDev=@VrBodaDev where FaktureId=@FaktureId
data.name: dtUpdateFaktureDevValute

data.command: select Zabrana from Partneri where PartneriId=@PartneriId
data.name: dtPartnerZabrana

data.command: spProd_Fakture_Storno_Ispravak
data.name: dtStornoIspravi

data.command: select count(*) as Broj from dimvrste
data.name: dtDimVrste

data.command: delete from CarpoFilter where CarpoFilterId=@CarpoFilterId
data.name: dtFilterDelete

data.command: select 1 as Id, 'Tekući tjedan' as Naziv union select 2, 'Tekući mjesec' union select 3, 'Tekući kvartal' union select 4, 'Tekuća godina'
data.name: dtFilterRazdoblje

data.command: select 1 as Id, 'Fakturirani' as Naziv union select 2, 'Nefakturirani' union select 3, 'Svi'
data.name: dtFilterFakturirani

data.command: select rajonid, opis as Naziv from rajoni
data.name: dtFilterRajoni

data.command: select o.OsobeId as OperateriId, RTRIM(o.Ime) + ' ' + RTRIM(o.Prezime) as Naziv from Osobe o where OperateriId is not null order by 2
data.name: dtFilterOperateri

data.command: select LNFaktureVrsteId,(Vrsta) as Naziv from LNFaktureVrste order by 1
data.name: dtVrstaPovezivanja

data.command: select coalesce(@par1, '') + char(13) + char(10) + coalesce(@par2, '') as tekst
data.name: dtNapomena

data.command: select count(*) as Broj, min(StatusiId) as StatusiMinId, max(StatusiId) as StatusiMaxId from Statusi where VrstaDokId=@VrstaDokId and Redoslijed = @Redoslijed + @Dodaj_Oduzmi and Aktivan = 1
data.name: dtStatusiBezForme

data.command: select count(*) as Broj, min(StatusiId) as StatusiMinId, max(StatusiId) as StatusiMaxId from Statusi where VrstaDokId=@VrstaDokId and Redoslijed = @Redoslijed + @Dodaj_Oduzmi and Aktivan = 1
data.name: dtStatusiBezFormeIzForme

data.name: dtVarKontrole
